description: Read what the behaviour tests offer for one of your agents: whether they are released for your workspace, the scenario pack for the agent's kind, whether your workspace's own Anthropic key is connected, the limits and the recent runs. In early access: it answers released false or not_released until it is switched on for your workspace. Runs never send real mail. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

agent_id.description: The agent to test: its id, as an agent shows in your workspace. An agent's own credential can name only its own agent.

name: get_agent_behaviour_tests
